```
POST /provision 403 {"error":"SAML assertion not accepted"}
```
Customer attrs mismatch (NameID vs email). Support tried regen metadata and re-upload — still 403.

raj_support: Steps done: re-uploaded IdP metadata, confirmed entityID, cleared caches, retried ingest job. Also saw 429 on embeds intermittently - likely rate config after retry storms.
